en.p: For a cubic function $f(x)$ with positive leading coefficient and the function $g(x)=e^{\sin\pi x}-1$, the composite function $h(x)=g(f(x))$ defined on the set of all real numbers satisfies the following conditions.

box: (A) The function $h(x)$ has a local maximum value 0 at $x=0$.
(B) The number of distinct real roots of the equation $h(x)=1$ in the open interval $(0,\,3)$ is 7.

en.p: When $f(3)=\dfrac{1}{2}$ and $f'(3)=0$, $f(2)=\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
